findings.problem: The example uses words not met before this card: Möchtest, einen. In the starter path it may use only earlier cards' words, its own, names, numbers and at most one obvious cognate.

back.example: Do you want a coffee? – No, thanks.

note: The Swiss footnote is right, since merci is the everyday thanks in Switzerland, and the card pairs well with "Ja, bitte." in the same unit.
